top_signals.summary: "As this is a matter concerning the honor of the Republic of Korea's people and nation, we cannot overlook it," he said.

top_signals.title: China warns foreign spies about crypto, Singapore dominates Asia: Asia Express
top_signals.summary: Singapore’s crypto economy grows 55%, South Korea set to make crypto market makers legal, and Chinese spy ministry warns would-be foreign spies it’s watching the blockchain.

top_signals.title: Franklin Templeton’s Mann on ETF Business in Asia
top_signals.summary:
David Mann, Global Head of ETFs & Market Structure at Franklin Templeton, says the firm’s latest partnership with ChinaAMC is the first step in its strategy to collaborate with local asset managers and gain exposure to investment themes in mainland China. He speaks on Bloomberg’s ETF IQ Asia.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Hong Kong Stocks Slump Most Since March, Led by Financials
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong’s stock benchmark led losses in Asia as trading resumed after a holiday, pressured by the recent surge in US yields and disappointment over China’s latest stimulus measures.

top_signals.title: Bitget `not expecting to recover a lot' from $388 million hack, CEO tells CNBC
top_signals.summary: Bitget has frozen a tiny fraction of the $387.5 million stolen in last week’s hack, and restored much of its protection fund.
